quest.title: Treasure and True Interest
quest.description: Kaveh mentioned a Kshahrewar senior of his who has somehow struck gold without taking any personal commissions. You resolve to ask him for some career tips.

chapter.title: The Pendulum of Weal and Woe

talks.objective: Go to Port Ormos and look for Alkami
Wait until after 07:00 the following day

dialogues.speaker: Read Teaching Materials
dialogues.text: (The materials cover a variety of architectural knowledge. At first glance, nothing appears to be amiss.)

dialogues.speaker: Adan
dialogues.text: Hey there. Can I help you?

choices.text: Do you know a man by the name of Alkami?

response.speaker: Adan
response.text: Oh, Alkami? You mean that rich guy who's been making quite the name for himself? Yeah, he commissioned a set of furniture from me a while back. Paid a great deal of Mora for it, too.

response.speaker: Adan
response.text: I heard he earned a fortune working as a renowned architect. Now he's opened a training center so others can follow in his footsteps.

response.speaker: Adan
response.text: If the tuition wasn't sky-high, I'd enroll my child in a heartbeat. Architecture really sounds like a lucrative profession...

choices.text: I'm wondering if you know anything about Alkami.

dialogues.speaker: Aabid
dialogues.text: Did you hear? Alkami recruited Kaveh to be an instructor!

dialogues.speaker: Adil
dialogues.text: Heh, I bet that'll boost his enrollment numbers!

dialogues.speaker: Aabid
dialogues.text: Really makes you jealous, eh? If you think about it, Alkami was never that talented himself as an architect. If we're just talking about professional skill, no one would pay for a class with him.

dialogues.speaker: Adil
dialogues.text: That's true, but you've got to admit, his advertisements are really effective... After all, the Akademiya only admits those that can pass its entrance exam, so only a few people could hope to study architecture in the halls of the Kshahrewar.

dialogues.speaker: Adil
dialogues.text: For those who can't pass the exam, or who just want to jump straight into the industry, the training center is the best bang for the Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Aabid
dialogues.text: Man, to have that kind of business acumen...

talks.objective: Wait for Kaveh's class to conclude
Go with Kaveh to confront Alkami
Collect information on tuition from the students
Find out more information from the merchant
Turn the loan shark in to the matra

Wait until after 08:00 the following day
Speak with the students standing around nearby

dialogues.speaker: Waiz
dialogues.text: Who cares about him? Maybe he's just worried that we'll take all of his commissions once we finally graduate!

dialogues.speaker: Tanisha
dialogues.text: B—But that can't be it, right? Mr. Kaveh is super famous...

dialogues.speaker: Waiz
dialogues.text: Who knows? My dad told me that the more famous someone is, the more arrogant and stubborn they become. Approachable people like Mr. Alkami are the rare ones!

dialogues.speaker: Nabil
dialogues.text: Hello. This institution has been shut down by order of the matra. We are currently conducting an investigation of all related personnel.

dialogues.speaker: Nabil
dialogues.text: Please come back tomorrow if you have any business here.

dialogues.speaker: Noticeboard
dialogues.text: A matra investigation has indicated that Alkami, the owner of this training center, coerced the families of his students to take on usurious loans with the intent of making huge profits.

dialogues.speaker: Noticeboard
dialogues.text: This training center is now closed. All recovered funds will be returned to the victims after confirmation with the relevant individuals.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You bring Fakhr to the Akademiya...
